title: The naive cotangent complex of a finitely presented morphism is etale locally a two-term complex of free modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a locally finitely presented morphism of algebraic spaces, the naive cotangent complex is shown to be etale locally quasi-isomorphic to a two-term complex of free modules. The proof reduces to a chart presentation of the morphism, applies the schemes statement to the chart morphism, and transports the quasi-isomorphism back using compatibility of the naive cotangent complex with etale localisation. The transport back along the chart is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 5440-5470.
